messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (signal) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is this a problem with Keelwater's product that a squad could act on? Pass means yes.
Fail if the cause is outside the product (pricing, contracts, the customer's own IT, staffing), if a help article would have answered it, or if it is praise.
A feature request or a described workaround is signal.
The evidence is the title, the problem statement and up to 12 customer quotes with route and date.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "problem_statement": "Exactly — we need garage progress visibility baked into the system so we don’t have to interrupt our daily work with phone calls. Could we schedule a follow-up call next Tuesday? I’ll need to align with my team’s shift roster",
 "quotes": [
  {
   "date": "2026-10-26T11:03:00Z",
   "quote": "Exactly — we need garage progress visibility baked into the system so we don’t have to interrupt our daily work with phone calls. Could we schedule a follow-up call next Tuesday? I’ll need to align with my team’s shift roster first.",
   "route": "sales"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-13T12:03:00+00:00",
   "quote": "Hi Bryn, I’m reaching out because we’ve got a few policyholders asking when they’ll get updates during their claim process. Is there a way to automate those messages?",
   "route": "support"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-19T10:29:00Z",
   "quote": "That’s all we ask — thanks again.",
   "route": "sales"
  }
 ],
 "title": "Exactly — we need garage progress visibility baked into the system so"
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The quotes describe a product gap: customers want garage progress visibility and automated claim-status updates built into the system, requiring manual phone calls today. This is a feature request (missing product capability), not pricing, customer IT, or something a help article would resolve. No praise or workaround contradiction appears in the evidence.", "verdict": "pass"}
